create_Speech2TextFeatureExtractor: create a Speech2TextFeatureExtractor instance with custom feature size, sampling rate, and num mel bins
build_fbank_features: build mel-filter bank features from raw speech waveform using TorchAudio or numpy fallback
run_normalize_features: run utterance-level cepstral mean and variance normalization on extracted input features
test_utterance_cmvn: test the utterance_cmvn static method for mean and variance normalization with padding support
summarize_call_method: summarize the __call__ method that featurizes raw speech into padded input features with attention mask
